If `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` returns nil, the import proceeds with a nil category, which will change behavior (likely defaulting to Uncategorized) rather than using the previous `embed_category`. The migration also deletes the `embed_category` site setting (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb), so there is no longer any fallback configured in settings, making this a real regression path when an embed import occurs without a matching EmbeddableHost row.
